args.title: Summary: Bellwether warehouse automation articles (2026)
args.body:
Combined summary of https://blog.bellwether.example/2026/warehouse and its companion piece (https://insights.bellwether.example/warehouse/companion):

- Warehouse automation in 2026: pick rates rose 18% with autonomous carts.
- Integration took twice as long as planned.
- Companion piece: the biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks.
